note: The Central Bank of Cyprus's directive (Κ.Δ.Π. 243/2024): lenders submit to ARTEMIS monthly, as of each month's last day, with no threshold, written as 30 days; a customer's overall report shows the amount in arrears and the days past due for the last thirty-six months, written as three years.
